crossRefs.note: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.
for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought…

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.
translations.bsb: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
translations.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
translations.asv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed about for seven days.
